basic_details.short_information: NLC India Limited (NLCIL) has released two separate apprenticeship notifications for the year 2026-27 for eligible candidates connected with NLCIL. The recruitment covers Trade (ITI), Non-Engineering Graduate, Engineering Graduate and Technician (Diploma) Apprentices. Across the two notifications, there are 1,235 apprenticeship training slots. Of these, 875 slots are for eligible wards of NLCIL Project Affected Persons (PAPs), while 360 slots are distributed between eligible wards/spouses of NLCIL employees and wards of specified NLCIL contract workmen. how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must submit their applications online through the Careers section of NLC India Limited. Candidates should first identify whether they are eligible under Advertisement No. L&DC/02/2026 or L&DC/03/2026.
Visit the Careers section of the NLC India Limited website.
Go to the Trainees & Apprentices section.
Select the applicable Advertisement No. L&DC/02/2026 or L&DC/03/2026.
Click on the Apply Online link for Trade/Graduate/Technician Apprentice.
Enter the required personal, educational and eligibility details.
Check all details before final submission.
Submit the application on or before 11 August 2026 at 5:00 PM.

content_sections.text: Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate and Technician Diploma candidates must have passed their qualifying examination in any of the following years: 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 The year-of-passing condition is not applicable to ITI candidates.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process is merit based. The method differs slightly according to the apprentice category. Selection of Trade Apprentices will be based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying ITI examination. For Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate and Technician Diploma Apprentices, selection will be based on the percentage of marks obtained in the relevant Bachelor's Degree or Diploma, calculated according to the procedure followed by the concerned university or institution. If grades or CGPA are awarded instead of percentage marks, conversion will be carried out according to the procedure prescribed by the university or institution. If two or more candidates obtain the same percentage of marks at the cut-off level, preference will be given to the older candidate based on date of birth.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLCIL Apprentice Application 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates may need to upload the following documents, depending on their apprentice category and eligibility group: Recent passport-size colour photograph Candidate's signature Transfer Certificate Aadhaar Card SSLC/10th Mark Sheet for date of birth proof HSC/12th Mark Sheet, where applicable ITI Certificate for Trade Apprentice candidates ITI semester-wise or consolidated mark sheets Degree/Diploma Certificate, as applicable Semester-wise or consolidated marks sheets Temporary Provisional Certificate, where applicable CGPA/OGPA conversion certificate, where applicable Community Certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates claiming reservation Disability Certificate for PwBD candidates, where applicable Other category-specific eligibility documents

content_sections.heading: Additional Documents for NLCIL PAP Candidates
content_sections.text: Eligible PAP candidates must obtain the PAP Certificate issued by the Land Department of NLC India Limited and upload it with the online application. The last date for submission of necessary documents to the Land Department for obtaining the PAP certificate is 7 August 2026.

content_sections.heading: NLC India Apprentice Reservation 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS and PwBD candidates will be provided as per the Apprentices Act and applicable rules. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the required certificate in the prescribed Government format. OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must submit a valid OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed format valid from 1 April 2026. If the required reservation certificate is not submitted, the candidate will be considered under the General category, subject to meeting the applicable eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q1. How many apprenticeship training slots are available under NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The two NLCIL apprenticeship notifications together cover 1,235 training slots. Advertisement No. L&DC/02/2026 has 875 slots for eligible PAP wards, while Advertisement No. L&DC/03/2026 provides 360 slots across its two eligible groups.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for specific NLCIL-connected eligibility groups. It includes eligible wards of NLCIL Project Affected Persons, eligible wards/spouses of in-service NLCIL employees, wards of retired or deceased NLCIL employees and eligible wards of specified NLCIL contract workmen.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NLCIL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Depending on the apprentice category, candidates should possess ITI, Diploma, B.E./B.Tech or a relevant Bachelor's Degree from a recognized institute, board or university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum age for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed at least 18 years of age as prescribed under the Apprentices Act.

faq.question: Q5. What is the NLC India Apprentice stipend?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend ranges from Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 15,028, depending on the apprenticeship category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the training duration for NLCIL Apprentices?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months.

faq.question: Q7. When does the NLCIL Apprentice online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 29 July 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply for NLC India Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 11 August 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NLC India Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualifying examination marks. Trade Apprentice selection is based on ITI marks, while Graduate and Technician Apprentice selection is based on marks in the relevant Degree or Diploma.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tentative joining date for NLCIL Apprentices?
faq.answer: The tentative joining date is 26 August 2026.
